question: Which one of the following dimensions of freedom is not mentioned in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Opportunity**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The dimension of **Opportunity** is not mentioned in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Preamble mentions the following dimensions of freedom: **Thought, Expression, Belief, Faith, and Worship**.
 
• It aims to provide justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity to all citizens.
